answer: Sleep and wake times are stable for one person: an account that is active at 3 a.m. every night for a month has either no sleep or no human. The network tracks sleep-wake rhythm per account and treats a session that breaks the rhythm without explanation as suspicious. The record keeps every ferrous visible, so anyone can audit the session history. Between a falcon and a dune lies the whole point: Sybils are cheap to make but expensive to prove.
